disk.method: Current lstat inventory; no symlink traversal; hardlinks deduplicated by device/inode; allocated bytes include directories. Active files can grow after observation. This is current artifact scope size, not a whole-filesystem historical net delta.

scope: Read-only checks except this script's atomic terminal-audit.json and resource-audit.json outputs.
Terminal failure is valid lifecycle evidence; supervisor/queue success does not replace inner numerical or performance results.
CPU duration sums CPU-only service wall elapsed, conservatively including dependency waits; not CPU core-hours or utilization.
NPU queue duration includes admission waits and setup; multiplied by requested device count, not claimed occupied device compute time. NPU service elapsed additionally includes predecessor waits.

Dependency wait, conservative post-dependency service, recorded serial worker-programme wall intervals and timed normal/warmup sections have separate boundaries and must not be added together. Unrecorded standalone-worker durations remain unavailable.
Cancelled v1 attempts remain included in service/wait accounting; absence of a queue record before cancellation does not invent a device workload. Replacement v2 jobs retain separate identities.

Allocator limits apply only to recorded per-process device observations; they are neither hard caps nor a claim about unrecorded concurrent parent/child occupancy. CPU allocator absence is not zero HBM.
Active jobs contribute provisional elapsed/RSS/disk observations but receive no terminal/source verification.
Supervisor affinity changes are separate saved records; no worker affinity or input is changed.
No external full argv, sensitive environment, model/device execution, process signals, or artifact cleanup.

limits: FP32 only in this finite plan; CPU FP64 only bounded local diagnosis.
One exclusively admitted idle Ascend910; no shared-NPU, CUDA, multi-NPU or 9B training qualification.
B16 medium training and B8 large inference; no new batch search or global optimum.
Fixed32 large Transformer is8.778371328B versus Tide7.268408784B; auxiliary reference does not replace joint A-D.
Normal/stage/operator passes and CPU NUMA placements remain distinct; finite differences and host contention are retained.
Throughput, mechanism checks and restoration do not establish downstream task quality.

standalone_recovery_details.boundary: one new reference next forward/update at the saved parameter/optimizer/private-state point; one actual further update after loading that same public checkpoint in a distinct interpreter

reference_anchor.meaning: new reference owner initialized from the preserved checkpoint, with newly declared empty gradients and RNG; not a claim of continuing the old process's unrecorded gradients/RNG

summary.support_policy: positive support differs: separate discrete failure, never only a finite-tolerance label

parent.scope: sampled process allocator peak, not a hard allocation cap; empty CPU allocator is a no-op

child.scope: sampled process allocator peak, not a hard allocation cap; empty CPU allocator is a no-op

memory_budget.interpretation: parent held allocation/reservation after synchronized cache release plus the child's cumulative peak; parent performs no device computation while waiting; this is a conservative process-allocator overlap bound, not a measured whole-device peak or opaque runtime-memory accounting

artifact_retention_scope.role: new reference next-update witness and declared gradient/RNG sidecar
artifact_retention_scope.retirement: successful comparison recorded; deterministic intermediate is reproducible from retained common anchor/checkpoint and frozen source
